notes: Patterns curated from cited mental health screening literature only. Any pattern without a verifiable source citation is marked 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and must be validated before production use. Regex patterns are case-insensitive and matched against full input text.

sources.name: Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)
sources.license: Free for non-commercial research and clinical use
sources.citation: Posner K, Brown GK, Stanley B, et al. The Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale: initial validity and internal consistency findings from three multisite studies. Am J Psychiatry. 2011;168(12):1266-1277.

sources.name: AFSP / SAMHSA Safe Messaging Guidelines
sources.citation: American Foundation for Suicide Prevention. Safe messaging guidelines on suicide. 2022.

sources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — Warning Signs
sources.citation: SAMHSA / HRSA 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. Warning signs of suicide. 2023.

sources.name: CLPsych Shared Task Lexicons
sources.citation: Coppersmith G, Dredze M, Harman C. Quantifying mental health signals in Twitter. Proceedings of the ACL Workshop on CLPsych. 2014.

suicide_ideation.description: Explicit or strong implicit reference to suicidal thoughts, plans, or intent. Sources: c_ssrs, 988_lifeline.
examples: I've been thinking about killing myself

self_harm.description: References to deliberate self-injury, current or planned. Sources: c_ssrs, safe_messaging.
examples: I hurt myself when I'm overwhelmed

immediate_danger.description: Signals of imminent risk, crisis state, or active emergency. Sources: 988_lifeline, c_ssrs.
examples: I'm going to do it tonight

review_log.change: Initial version 1.0.0 — patterns sourced from C-SSRS, AFSP safe messaging guidelines, 988 Lifeline warning signs, and CLPsych shared task lexicons. All patterns have citation. No NEEDS_REVIEW flags at creation.

v1.0.1 — fixed regex gaps found in smoke test: (1) self-harm\b → self-harm\w* to catch 'self-harming'; (2) made apostrophes optional in I'm patterns (I'?m) to match text without apostrophes; (3) added don't want to live / want to not exist variants to suicide_ideation.
